# Kenney CC0 audio sources

Author: Kenney. Primary repository: https://github.com/KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-FPS
Pinned commit: 185fd2326d74a5cf858cffc616f87cf9696f9cc0
Official README explicitly dedicates included sound effects under CC0 1.0:
https://github.com/KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-FPS/tree/185fd2326d74a5cf858cffc616f87cf9696f9cc0

Five unmodified source Ogg files retained; their Git blob SHA1 values were verified
against the official commit tree. walking.ogg is decoded to mono/22050Hz and four
individual 0.32-second footfalls are cut, faded and peak-normalized by
tools/make_combat_audio.py. land/jump sources are retained but not currently wired.
Weapon/impact cues in assets/audio/combat are original synthesis, not Kenney audio.
No downloaded game code is used. UPSTREAM_README/UPSTREAM_LICENSE preserve the
repository's distinct software MIT and asset CC0 declarations. LICENSE.txt ships
with exports. No endorsement implied.
